neighbours.notes: Cold step-in (labelled from own tops and probes only). Broad pole (1.4% of tokens at 0.1). Probes: 'will be a wonderful addition' 0.36-0.62 vs 'is a wonderful addition' 0.09-0.24; 'is going to be a great fit' 0.28 without a modal; scheduled 'will arrive/sign' ~0.11; German forecast silent in the solver. Blind test written by a label-only second author.
